headline: President Clinton created an advisory commission to study U.S. trade and investment policy with countries in the Pacific region.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy. Based on its title, the commission's job was to study and give advice on U.S. trade and investment with Pacific and Asian nations. No summary was provided, so details about its members, duties, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would receive advice from the commission on trade and investment with Pacific countries.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. businesses that trade with or invest in Pacific countries
who_it_affects.how: Their interests were the subject of the commission's review, though the order itself did not set new rules for them.
